## About
I am an associate professor in computer and data science at [Mount Royal University](https://www.mtroyal.ca/). I am interested in far too many things, but primarily open source software, vector graphics, document manipulation, and fibre arts. I like to build accessible and practical tools, particularly those that make it easier to work with digital sewing patterns.
